experiment: DCF-22 compact recurrent model trained on the DCF-16 curriculum

data.train: DCF-16 train (600) plus train_large: fresh records from the same four training families and sizes
data.heldout: DCF-16 heldout (200), scored once after models and predictions are committed

inputs: factor tokens of the query component (far-to-near by hop distance, nearest max_tokens kept) and global structure/budget/operator-cost features; no operator posterior is an input
loss: BCE(posterior, verified reference) + CE(choice, DCF-16 selected option, masked to affordable operators) + cost_weight * MSE(log2 exact cost / 20)

gates.G1: selector (choice head, acting on the chosen operator's stored action) is non-inferior to the EvalMath symbolic predictor in held-out expected utility (bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean paired difference > -0.01) and uses fewer mean counted operator ops, for at least 2 of 3 GRU seeds
gates.G2: GRU posterior MSE against the verified reference is lower than the parameter-matched MLP's on held-out, on the mean over seeds and in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds
gates.G3: acting on the GRU's own posterior beats loopy BP at the record's budget (bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean paired expected-utility difference > 0) for at least 2 of 3 seeds

compute_note: model multiply-accumulates are reported per prediction (mean_macs) next to counted operator ops; they are different units and neither gate charges them
